## Activity

During December 2021, River Outreach recorded 30 captures. This figure represents the complete activity reported for the period. The activity record provides the basis for the image-quality review and subsequent grading assessment. No further activity figures are included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 30 captures, 2 were ungradable. The resulting ungradable rate was 6.7 per cent. This measure records the proportion of captures that could not be assessed for grading and is presented alongside the underlying count for clarity. The image-quality result is therefore reported as both the number of ungradable captures and the associated rate.

## Grading

The grading review identified 3 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 0 days. This indicates that the reported median interval between the image being captured and the grading outcome was 0. The grading summary is presented with the referable count and median lag together so that the volume of findings and the timeliness measure can be read in context.
